front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《42》

zh: 左邊是青山，右邊是青山
en: To the left, green mountains; to the right, green mountains
In the middle, a line of egrets
Flying into a Tang dynasty poem

points.zh:
两個黃鸝鳴翠柳，一行白鷺上青天。
窗含西岭千秋雪，門泊東吳萬里船。
--唐。杜甫《絕句》
points.en:
Two golden orioles sing amid the emerald willows; a row of white egrets rises into the blue sky.
My window frames the snow of the western ridge, unchanged for a thousand autumns; at my gate are moored boats from distant Wu, ten thousand miles away.
-- Du Fu (Tang dynasty), "Quatrain"

en: The night is dim and dark
We sit together in silence
Watching how starlight falls upon the lake's shore
Late spring, a light rain
Outside the window, no one
Farther still, the grass color faint and hazy

zh: 大江東去，帶走一片月色
是非成敗，只剩一壼濁酒
en: The great river flows east, carrying away a stretch of moonlight
Right and wrong, success and failure — all that remains is a jug of cloudy wine
The green mountains remain, the setting sun faintly red

points.zh: 《唐吉訶德》 ( Don  Quixote )  是西班牙作家塞萬提斯的作品 ( 1615 ) ，被認為是西班牙的文學典範，也是現代西方文學的奠基作品之一。書中主角唐吉訶德是一個瘦小的沒落貴族，戴著破了洞的頭盔，拿著生銹的長矛，騎着疲憊的瘦馬，和僕人桑多行走天下，打抱不平。整個經歷在幻想和現實，在動機善良和行為盲目中進行。是一個集矛盾於一身，旣可喜又可悲的人物。其中最精彩的一幕是 : 把風車群當做撲面而來的巨人，而與之大戰一埸，卻弄得遍体傷痕累累。
points.en: "Don Quixote" (Don Quixote) is a work by the Spanish writer Miguel de Cervantes (1615), regarded as a paragon of Spanish literature and one of the foundational works of modern Western literature. The protagonist, Don Quixote, is a gaunt, declined nobleman who, wearing a helmet with a hole in it, wielding a rusted lance, and riding an exhausted, skinny horse, travels the world together with his servant Sancho, righting wrongs wherever he goes. His whole experience unfolds between fantasy and reality, between good intentions and blind action—a figure who embodies contradiction in one body, at once comic and tragic. The most celebrated scene is when he mistakes a group of windmills for giants bearing down on him and does battle with them, only to end up covered from head to toe in wounds and bruises.

en: Rowing a boat across the Milky Way
Scooping up the brightest star
Lighting a lamp for the one returning on a snowy night

points.zh:
日暮蒼山遠，天寒白屋貧。
柴門聞犬吠，風雪夜歸人。
--唐 。劉長卿《逢雪宿芙蓉山主人》
points.en:
At dusk the green mountains stretch far away; in the cold, a thatched hut stands poor.
At the brushwood gate a dog is heard barking; in wind and snow, someone returns home at night.
-- Tang dynasty. Liu Changqing, 'Stopping at Mount Furong in the Snow, at My Host's Home'

en: After sunset, longing
Thinned into a wisp of cooking smoke
Waiting quietly for the returning geese
Zhuangzi naps at noon, dreams of a butterfly
Vivid and lifelike, flying out
String after string of butterfly effects

points.zh:
“ 昔者莊周夢爲蝴蝶，栩栩然蝴蝶也，自喻適志與！不知周也。俄然覺，則蘧蘧然周也。不知周之夢爲蝴蝶與，蝴蝶之夢爲周與？周與蝴蝶，則必有分矣。此之謂物化。”
-- 戰國 。莊子《齊物論》
蝴蝶效應（The Butterfly Effect）是指在一个動力系統中，初始條件下微小的變化能带動整個系统的長期的巨大的連鎖反應。這是一種混沌現象。任何事物發展均存在定數與變數，事物在發展過程中其發展軌迹有規律可循，同時也存在不可测的“ 變數 ”，往往還會適得其反，一个微小的變化能影響事物的發展，說明事物的發展具有複雜性。對于這個效應最常見的闡述是：“ 一隻南美洲亞馬遜河流域熱帶雨林中的蝴蝶，偶爾扇動幾下翅膀，可以在两周以后引起美國德克薩斯州的一場龍捲風“。其原因就是蝴蝶扇動翅膀的運動，導致其身邊的空氣系统發生變化，并產生微弱的氣流，而微弱的氣流的產生又會引起四周空氣或其他系统產生相應的變化，由此引起一個連鎖反應，最终導致其他系统的極大變化。
points.en:
"Once, Zhuang Zhou dreamed he was a butterfly, a butterfly fluttering about, enjoying itself. It did not know it was Zhuang Zhou. Suddenly he awoke, and there he was, unmistakably Zhuang Zhou. He did not know whether he, Zhuang Zhou, had dreamed he was a butterfly, or whether the butterfly had dreamed it was Zhuang Zhou. Between Zhuang Zhou and the butterfly there must be some distinction. This is called the transformation of things."
-- Warring States period. Zhuangzi, "Discussion on Making All Things Equal" (Qiwulun)
The Butterfly Effect refers to the phenomenon whereby, within a dynamic system, a minute change in initial conditions can set off a long-term, enormous chain reaction throughout the entire system. This is a form of chaotic phenomenon. In the development of anything there exist both fixed factors and variables; the trajectory of development follows certain discernible patterns, yet there also exist unpredictable "variables," which often produce results contrary to expectation — showing that the development of things is inherently complex. The most common illustration of this effect is: "A butterfly in the Amazon rainforest of South America flaps its wings a few times, and this can, two weeks later, trigger a tornado in Texas, USA." The reason is that the motion of the butterfly's wing-flapping causes changes in the air system around it, producing a faint air current; this faint air current in turn causes corresponding changes in the surrounding air or other systems, thereby triggering a chain reaction that ultimately leads to enormous changes in other systems.

en: Autumn day, the wild geese return home
Fallen leaves cover the steps
A person stands alone
And time comes no more
Time is at last no more
Jiuqutang Station, no longer

points.zh: 九曲堂，位於下淡水溪旁，是昔日屏東和高雄之間的一個小村落。高中時從台南回屏東，火車停靠九曲堂時，就知道，再過去就是跨越下淡水溪的鐵橋，大武山就橫立在遠處天際，屏東就快到了。如今，鐵軌改道，鐵橋重建，火車不再停靠九曲堂車站。下淡水溪也改名爲高屏溪。
points.en: Jiuqutang, located beside the Xiadanshui River, was once a small village between Pingtung and Kaohsiung. In high school, traveling back to Pingtung from Tainan, whenever the train stopped at Jiuqutang, I knew that just beyond lay the iron bridge crossing the Xiadanshui River, with Mount Dawu standing on the distant horizon -- Pingtung was almost there. Now, the railway route has been changed, the iron bridge has been rebuilt, and trains no longer stop at Jiuqutang Station. The Xiadanshui River has also been renamed the Gaoping River.

flow.caption_zh: 横跨下淡水溪的舊鐵橋。位於屏東縣六塊厝和高雄縣九曲堂

zh: 之間，建造於日本時期，曾經是台灣最長的鐵橋，也是亞州
第一長鐵橋，如今廢棄不用。在舊䥫橋上漫步，有時可以看
見火車駛過遠方新造的鐵橋。
en: In between, built during the Japanese era, it was once Taiwan's longest railway bridge, and also Asia's
The first long iron bridge, now abandoned and unused. Strolling on the old iron bridge, sometimes one can see
seeing a train pass over the newly built iron bridge in the distance.

points.zh:
《 車站 》
詞 / 曲：林垂立
火車已經到車站　阮的心頭漸漸重
看人歡喜來接親人　阮是傷心來相送
無情的喇叭聲音　聲聲彈
月台邊依依難捨　心所愛的人
火車已經過車站　阮的眼眶已經紅
車窗內心愛的人　只有期待夜夜夢
張秀卿（屏東恒春人）1993年以《車站》（想厝的心情專輯）獲得第六届金曲奬最佳台語女歌手。
points.en:
"The Station"
Lyrics/Music: Lin Chui-li
The train has already reached the station, my heart grows heavier and heavier
I watch others happily come to meet their loved ones, while I have come sorrowfully to see mine off
The heartless sound of the whistle rings out again and again
By the platform I cannot bear to part from the one my heart loves
The train has already passed through the station, my eyes are already red
The one I love, inside the train window, leaves me only to wait for her in my dreams night after night
Chang Hsiu-ching (a native of Hengchun, Pingtung) won Best Taiwanese-language Female Singer at the 6th Golden Melody Awards in 1993 for "The Station" (from the album "Longing for Home").
